36-11-01A.t: Engine Bleed Air Supply System (non-EDTO flights)
36-11-01A.txt:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS
     EDTO is not conducted.



   The flight crew should take into account the severity of forecast icing conditions. The wing anti-ice
   will be lost if the remaining engine bleed air supply system becomes inoperative.
   Note:      In case one bleed air supply system is inoperative, the wing anti-ice system remains
              available.
   Due to a limitation of the bleed design, the remaining engine bleed air supply system can supply
   only one pack, regardless of the wing anti-ice status.
    If ENG 1 bleed is affected:
       One engine taxi is not permitted.
 FLIGHT CREW
   Contact dispatcher for flight release update and “FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS”
   confirmation.
 AFTER ENGINE START
    If two engine taxi at departure:
     ENG BLEED (affected side) pb-sw ..................................................................................... OFF
     AFT CARGO HOT AIR (If Installed) pb-sw ......................................................................... OFF
      If both PACKs are operative:
          PACK (affected side) pb-sw ..........................................................................................OFF
        X BLEED rotary selector ...................................................................................................OPEN
    If one engine taxi at departure:
      If ENG 2 bleed is affected:
           After engine 2 start:
             ENG BLEED 2 pb-sw ............................................................................................. OFF
             AFT CARGO HOT AIR (If Installed) pb-sw ............................................................ OFF
              If both PACKs are operative:
                 PACK 2 pb-sw ..................................................................................................OFF
                   X BLEED rotary selector ..................................................................................... OPEN
 AFTER TAKEOFF
    If the APU has been used to supply the air conditioning during the takeoff:
     APU BLEED pb-sw ................................................................................................................ Off






      If takeoff was performed with PACKs OFF and both packs operative:
       PACK (non-affected side) pb-sw ............................................................................................On
       Disregard AIR PACK 1(2) OFF alert for the PACK intentionally kept off.
  IN FLIGHT
      In the case of failure of the remaining engine bleed air supply system, or in the case of
       failure of the associated engine:

                              BLEED pb-sw is placarded inoperative as per MEL 36-11-01.
